program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let ((seed-color (if (zero? (mod r 2))
                                          (if (and (>= c 0) (< c w) (!= 0 (at g 0 c)))
                                              (at g 0 c)
                                              0)
                                          (if (and
                                                (>= (- c 1) 0)
                                                (< (- c 1) w)
                                                (!= 0 (at g 0 (- c 1))))
                                              (at g 0 (- c 1))
                                              0))))
                      seed-color)))))
